decisions.reason: Launched in 2023 with a multi-model product line and its own web page, it has generated visible commitment and sunk costs that escalation pressures make management reluctant to abandon despite modest visibility.

As the flagship platform shown on the home page since 2023 and central to the firm's announced agency-focused direction, it carries the strongest public commitment and investment, making dropping highly unlikely.
Close to the established offer and consistently presented on its own page since 2023, it represents moderate sunk costs and justification pressures, so management tends to persist with it.

Although launched later with only a brief website mention and therefore less accumulated commitment, its fit with the firm's security and compliance direction still creates enough sunk-cost and strategic-consistency pressure to favor keeping it for now.
